topic: Bartolomeo's devotion to Luffy traces back to one Loguetown execution-platform moment, and it turns his fanboying into real loyalty
title: Why Bartolomeo Idolizes Luffy More Than Anyone
description:
Bartolomeo's worship of Luffy looks like a running gag, but the root goes back to one moment in Loguetown. This breakdown follows that moment through the Party chapter, the Dressrosa Colosseum and the Grand Fleet, and argues the comedy is hiding real loyalty. Do you think his devotion is sincere, or is the fanboy act a joke the story keeps milking?
